description:
Check a domain's DNS, HTTPS/TLS, email security and AI-agent readiness, including robots.txt, llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP and x402 discovery.
USE WHEN: agent needs a single-call domain inspection across DNS, web, email, security, and agent-readiness signals.
DO NOT USE WHEN: agent only needs DNS records; narrower domain/DNS products are not exposed through MCP.
Parameter semantics: `domain` is required; optional `previous_state` enables stateless change detection against a prior `new_state`.

domain.description: Public domain name for consolidated domain health, DNS, TLS, and email-posture inspection; localhost and IP literals are rejected.
domain.title: Domain

previous_state.description: Optional prior new_state for stateless change detection.
previous_state.title: Previous State

name: domain_agent_readiness_check

email_posture.description: Observed email posture including MX, SPF, and DMARC.

health.description: Observed domain health: DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, redirects, TLS, and latency.

security_posture.description: Observed HTTPS/TLS security posture; not a safety verdict.

title: Domain & Agent Readiness Check
